fusions.name: Through the Plate
fusions.desc: Your swarm gnaws into one enemy's armour, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rust-Mouthed Pack
fusions.desc: Looses 3 rats at once, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Behind the Grate
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 6%. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gnaw-Scarred Plating
fusions.desc: Conjures scavenged armour: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
